description: Trim a WAV audio file to a time range with optional fade in and out, returning a 16-bit PCM WAV as base64. Only WAV is accepted; the web UI handles MP3/OGG/M4A.

endSec.description: Trim end in seconds, after startSec.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

name: trim_audio

data.description: Trimmed audio as a 16-bit PCM WAV, base64.

durationSec.description: Duration of the trimmed audio in seconds.

title: Trim a WAV audio file
